title: 地点：来到成都的新景区
source_sentence: We have just entered our next spot in the middle of Chengdu, and it's this beautiful scenic area.
pairs: We have just entered our next spot,
我们刚刚来到下一站，
in the middle of Chengdu,
位于成都市区中部，
and it's this beautiful scenic area.
而这里是一处美丽的景区。
note: spot 在这里指旅行中的“景点、下一站”。

title: 期待：再过几分钟就能看到民乐
source_sentence: And I think, in a few minutes' time, we're going to be able to see some Chinese folk music.
pairs: And I think, in a few minutes' time,
我想，再过几分钟，
we're going to be able to see some Chinese folk music.
我们就能看到一些中国民乐。
note: be going to 表示将要发生的事；be able to 表示“能够”。

title: 回忆：第一次旅行没看过民乐
source_sentence: Now, I never saw Chinese folk music on my first trip, so quite excited to see it here.
pairs: Now, I never saw Chinese folk music on my first trip,
我第一次旅行时没看过中国民乐，
so quite excited to see it here.
所以这次能在这里看到，我挺期待。
note: so quite excited 是自然口语中的省略，完整表达可以说 so I'm quite excited。

title: 环境：树木和乐器增添氛围（1/2）
source_sentence: The instruments make such a beautiful sound, and being surrounded by all these trees and this beautiful Chinese architecture in this area just, like, adds to that atmosphere.
pairs: The instruments make such a beautiful sound,
这些乐器发出的声音如此优美，
and being surrounded by all these trees
而且被这些树木环绕
note: 下一页继续同一句；being surrounded by 描述身处其中的环境。

title: 环境：树木和建筑增添氛围（2/2）
source_sentence: The instruments make such a beautiful sound, and being surrounded by all these trees and this beautiful Chinese architecture in this area just, like, adds to that atmosphere.
pairs: and this beautiful Chinese architecture,
以及这些美丽的中国建筑，
in this area just, like, adds to that atmosphere.
在这里就仿佛增添了这种氛围。
note: just, like 是口语填充语；add to 表示“给原有氛围再增添一些感觉”。

title: 体验：音乐结束后可以试奏乐器（1/2）
source_sentence: Okay, that was so awesome, so after the music we were able to try and, like, play the instruments, and that, like, violin kind of thing was incredible.
pairs: Okay, that was so awesome.
好了，刚才真的太棒了。
So, after the music, we were able to try
音乐结束后，我们可以试着
and, like, play the instruments,
演奏这些乐器，
note: after the music 表示“音乐结束后”；like 在这里是口语填充语。

title: 体验：那个像小提琴的东西很神奇（2/2）
source_sentence: Okay, that was so awesome, so after the music we were able to try and, like, play the instruments, and that, like, violin kind of thing was incredible.
pairs: and that, like, violin kind of thing
而那个有点像小提琴的东西
was incredible.
真的很神奇。
words: 那一类的东西，表示不确定准确名称
note: kind of thing 表示说话者不确定乐器的准确名称。

title: 细节：动作稍有不同，声音就不同
source_sentence: You have to be so delicate on all the strings because a slight different movement, and it makes a completely different sound.
pairs: You have to be so delicate on all the strings
拨弄这些弦时必须非常轻巧
because a slight different movement,
因为动作稍有不同，
and it makes a completely different sound.
发出的就是完全不同的声音。
note: 原话是 a slight different movement；更自然的表达是 a slightly different movement。

title: 评价：挺让人困惑，但很好玩
source_sentence: Very confusing, but yeah, good fun.
pairs: Very confusing,
真的让人摸不着头脑，
but yeah, good fun.
不过，确实很好玩。
note: good fun 是常见的口语表达，意思是“很有趣、很好玩”。

title: 历史：景区有一千年历史
source_sentence: This beautiful scenic area is actually a thousand years old, and it used to be a private land, a private park.
pairs: This beautiful scenic area is actually a thousand years old,
这处美丽的景区其实已经有一千年历史，
and it used to be a private land, a private park.
过去曾是私人土地、一座私人园林。
note: used to be 表示过去的状态；private land 和 private park 都表示不对公众开放。

title: 开放：过去不对公众开放（1/2）
source_sentence: It wasn't open to the public, but it was owned by the government, and the government were able to come around and just relax in this beautiful area.
pairs: It wasn't open to the public,
它当时不对公众开放，
but it was owned by the government,
而是归政府所有，
note: was owned by 是被动表达，说明这片地方归谁所有。

title: 开放：政府可以来这里休息（2/2）
source_sentence: It wasn't open to the public, but it was owned by the government, and the government were able to come around and just relax in this beautiful area.
pairs: and the government were able to come around
政府方面的人可以过来
and just relax in this beautiful area.
在这片美丽的地方放松休息。
note: come around 在这里指到这个地方来，不是“改变主意”。
